dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I can't believe I'm leaving Bangkok next month. I wish I had more time here.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈkænt bɪˈliːv aɪm ˈliːvɪŋ ˈbæŋkɑːk ˈnɛkst ˈmʌnθ. aɪ ˈwɪʃ aɪ ˈhæd ˈmɔːr ˈtaɪm ˈhɪr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Me too. I wish you didn't have to go.
dialogue.reading: ˈmiː ˈtuː. aɪ ˈwɪʃ juː ˈdɪdənt ˈhæf tə ˈɡoʊ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Are you OK, Nam? You look tired.
dialogue.reading: ər juː oʊˈkeɪ, ˈnɑːm? juː ˈlʊk ˈtaɪərd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'm a bit stressed out. I have three exams next week, and I work every weekend.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ə ˈbɪt ˈstrɛst ˈaʊt. aɪ ˈhæv ˈθriː ɪɡˈzæmz ˈnɛkst ˈwiːk, ənd aɪ ˈwɜːrk ˈɛvri ˈwiːkɛnd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: You work too hard. I wish you had more free time.
dialogue.reading: juː ˈwɜːrk ˈtuː ˈhɑːrd. aɪ ˈwɪʃ juː ˈhæd ˈmɔːr ˈfriː ˈtaɪm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: So do I. But I'm saving money for a trip to Canada!
dialogue.reading: ˈsoʊ duː ˈaɪ. bʌt aɪm ˈseɪvɪŋ ˈmʌni fər ə ˈtrɪp tə ˈkænədə!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Really? Are you satisfied with your job at the restaurant?
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? ər juː ˈsætɪsfaɪd wɪð jʊr ˈdʒɑːb ət ðə ˈrɛstərɑːnt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Mostly. I wish I earned more, but my boss is kind.
dialogue.reading: ˈmoʊstli. aɪ ˈwɪʃ aɪ ˈɜːrnd ˈmɔːr, bʌt maɪ ˈbɔːs ɪz ˈkaɪnd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: You worry too much, Nam. You're a great student, and you'll find a great job one day.
dialogue.reading: juː ˈwɜːri ˈtuː ˈmʌtʃ, ˈnɑːm. jʊr ə ˈɡreɪt ˈstuːdənt, ənd juːl ˈfaɪnd ə ˈɡreɪt ˈdʒɑːb ˈwʌn ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thanks. I'm lucky to have friends like you.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks. aɪm ˈlʌki tə ˈhæv ˈfrɛndz laɪk ˈjuː.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh, Nam. I wish we lived in the same country!
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, ˈnɑːm. aɪ ˈwɪʃ wiː ˈlɪvd ɪn ðə ˈseɪm ˈkʌntri!
